items.title: TikTok Shop's black friday LIVEs
items.body: TikTok Shop is calling this its biggest LIVE shopping moment ever: daily live-only deals through nov 30, up to 60% off viral stuff. in the UK, 53% of gen z say they'll shop it this weekend.

items.title: a 24-hour electronics livestream
items.creator: @triedbymrandmrsp
items.body: a creator couple is hosting a 24-hour electronics LIVE on TikTok Shop starting tomorrow morning (UK time). 24 hours of gadgets. i could never.

items.title: "he wanna pay full price" is still climbing
items.creator: @joejonas
items.body: the SNL Druski clip about paying full price is up another 220% this week, which feels very appropriate for black friday.

items.title: gen z LOVES a dupe
items.body: 49% of gen z have bought a dupe, the highest of any generation. why pay full price when the copy is right there.

items.title: black friday is still their thing
items.body: McKinsey says gen z is the most likely generation to start holiday shopping on black friday. and more of them plan to shop in stores this year (37%, up from 27%).

items.title: the influencer IS the shopping list
items.body: 35% of gen z find products through influencers (vs 19% of everyone else), and 64% research products on social media first.

items.title: Y2K is still in the cart
items.body: cargo pants, claw clips and baby tees are all still on gen z's lists this holiday season.
